item.title: Smoke over Rio de Janeiro: Deadly anti-gang raid leaves 64 dead, including 4 police officers — watch video
item.description: A massive police operation targeting the Comando Vermelho gang in Rio de Janeiro resulted in at least 64 deaths, including four officers, marking the deadliest raid in the city's history. The operation, involving 2,500 security personnel, occurred days before Rio hosts major global climate events.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Influencer Ben Bader’s final moments revealed after TikTok star found unresponsive inside Florida home
item.description: TikTok sensation Ben Bader, 25, was found unresponsive at his Florida home and tragically passed away despite resuscitation efforts. Authorities are investigating the cause of his sudden death, with all possibilities, including health issues or foul play, not ruled out. His girlfriend and family remember him as a kind, positive individual whose legacy will inspire many.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Kai Cenat 2025: Age, weight, height, current salary, personal details and more
item.description: From the Bronx to global stardom, Kai Cenat, 23, has redefined online entertainment. His energetic streams, celebrity collaborations, and viral content have propelled him to immense success. item.title: Is Mizkif single? Relationship status of the Twitch streamer before and after the Emiru controversy
item.description: Twitch star Mizkif faces serious allegations from ex-girlfriend Emiru, who accused him of emotional abuse and sexual assault. While Mizkif denies assault claims, their public fallout led to his departure from the streamer group OTK. Currently, both Mizkif and Emiru appear to be single, with no new relationships publicly confirmed.

item.title: Twitch stars TimTheTatman, Emiru and CouRageJD join official NASCAR 25 Creator Series in first-ever live crossover with real pro drivers
item.description: NASCAR is launching the NASCAR 25 Creator Series with online media company Night. Eight popular streamers will compete in live races from October to February. This initiative aims to connect with younger audiences through their favorite online personalities. The series will feature interactive broadcasts and a significant prize pool, boosting NASCAR's presence in gaming.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Watch: TikTok mom Misty Huron shares nightmare horror baby monitor video as viewers spot something terrifying on the top bunk
item.description: A TikTok user, Misty Huron, shared a chilling baby monitor video showing a dark, human-like shadow darting across her daughter's top bunk. Despite her immediate check revealing no one present, the monitor continued to detect motion, leaving viewers debating if it was a spirit or a trick of light. The incident has sparked widespread fear and speculation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: North Korea fires cruise missiles ahead of Donald Trump-Xi Jinping meeting in South Korea
item.description: North Korea launched sea-to-surface cruise missiles into western waters, a move that could bolster its nuclear-armed military. This occurred just before US President Trump's arrival in South Korea for talks. Pyongyang has shunned negotiations with Washington and Seoul since 2019, with leader Kim Jong Un now prioritizing Russia and opposing denuclearization demands.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Cognitive confusion: Donald Trump refers to dementia screening as 'very hard' IQ test
item.description: President Trump claimed to have aced a "very hard" IQ test at Walter Reed, challenging political opponents. However, experts confirm the exam was the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), a tool for detecting early cognitive decline, not an intelligence test. This misrepresentation raises concerns about health communication and political messaging.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘California is my home, we wouldn’t leave if..’: Sam Altman on OpenAI’s deal with the state
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has pledged to remain in California, resolving a dispute with the state's Attorney General. This agreement paves the way for OpenAI's transition to a public-benefit corporation and solidifies Microsoft's 27% ownership stake. Altman's stance contrasts with tech firms threatening relocation, emphasizing California's crucial role in AI development and the need for regulatory collaboration.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sydney Sweeney grilled on social media for hinting at playing James Bond: ‘You're a woman, so no’
item.description: Sydney Sweeney expressed interest in playing James Bond, sparking online debate. Critics resurfaced controversies, including a viral jeans ad and her mother's birthday party guests wearing MAGA hats, linking her to conservative support. Sweeney's Republican registration and Donald Trump's defense further fueled the discussion.

item.title: Mizkif and Emiru old clip resurfaces online and reignites abuse backlash after he is heard calling her “pathetic”
item.description: An old video of streamer Mizkif speaking harshly to Emiru has resurfaced. In the clip, Mizkif calls Emiru 'weak' and 'pathetic' while friends laugh. Emiru appears uncomfortable. The video has gone viral, with fans angry at the behavior being treated as entertainment. This incident is seen as a clear sign of a toxic time between them.

item.title: Who is Emiru’s boyfriend? Exploring the relationship status of the popular Twitch streamer
item.description: Twitch star Emiru is reportedly single following a highly publicized breakup with fellow streamer Mizkif. Accusations of emotional abuse and sexual assault surfaced in late 2025, dividing fans. Despite the controversy, Emiru remains focused on her career, prioritizing her mental well-being and continuing to engage her large fanbase with gaming and cosplay content.

item.title: UAE: Fire contained in Abu Dhabi’s Musaffah industrial area; no casualties reported
item.description: A fire broke out in several shops in Abu Dhabi’s Musaffah Industrial Area on Tuesday evening. Emergency teams from Abu Dhabi Police and Civil Defence quickly contained it, with no casualties or structural damage reported. Cooling and smoke extraction operations followed. Investigations into the cause are ongoing, while authorities urged the public to rely on verified information. This is the area’s second recent fire.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Does Mizkif own stake in OTK? Detailes revealed as platform fully supports Emiru in assault controversy
item.description: Streaming giant OTK has severed all ties with Mizkif following serious allegations of physical and sexual assault by Emiru. Other streamers, including Quqco, BogWytch, and AriaSaki, have also come forward with accusations. Mizkif denies assault but admits to a toxic relationship. OTK publicly supports Emiru and has confirmed Mizkif's complete removal from the company.

item.title: Viral on Instagram: Labour MP roasts Nigel Farage’s maths skills with a hilarious dig
item.description: Labour MP Adam Thompson humorously highlighted Nigel Farage's significant miscalculation of government savings during Prime Minister's Questions. Thompson pointed out Farage's claim of £7 billion in savings was actually only £27 million, a discrepancy that drew laughter in the Commons and has since gone viral online.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Elon Musk attacks 'legacy media' again, this time defending his AI-powered database Grokipedia
item.description: Elon Musk has launched Grokipedia, an AI-driven alternative to Wikipedia, which he claims will pursue truth without bias. However, early versions of Grokipedia have been found to adapt content directly from Wikipedia, prompting criticism. Musk defended his project against accusations of far-right bias from traditional media outlets.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why Chetan Bhagat moved to Dubai and how the city became the muse for his new book
item.description: Chetan Bhagat, India’s bestselling author, has quietly moved to Dubai seeking calm, discipline, and creative renewal. He says the city’s quiet energy and distance from fame helped him rediscover focus and “the old Chetan Bhagat,” shaping his latest novel 12 Years: My Messed-Up Love Story, a return to writing born from solitude rather than spotlight.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Praneeth Kumar Usiripalli? Indian-origin man who stabbed two teens with a fork mid-air, faces 10 years in prison, $250,000 fine
item.description: An Indian-origin man, Praneeth Kumar Usiripalli, was arrested in Boston after allegedly stabbing two teenagers with a metal fork on a Lufthansa flight from Chicago. The incident forced an emergency landing, and Usiripalli, who had overstayed his student visa, faces charges of assault with a dangerous weapon.
